searchText: This is great! I am curious about two things: 1) Outstanding spikes on 90th percentile 2) Growth of the worst case times related to Shapella Yeah on 1) I think that at least one of those was around the time we say finality issues, but haven't looked closely. For 2) it's really hard to track down any sort of root cause given the combination of consenus and execution nodes contributing to the overall result, but will have a look and see if there is anything in terms of a specific node combination that's bringing in those high humbers. 1) If labels on the time axis are correct that spike isn't related to the non-finality periods. 2) considering that a median of processing time for various client combinations is taken i assume that more than a half of combinations are slow at processing those outliers, so I'd thought the cause is unlikely in any client combination being slower than others For 90th percentile I'm taking the 90th percentile processing time for each slot, then the 90th percentile of the slots in the day. Sorry, that probably wasn't clear from my prior comments. Rough consensus in ACDE to add `parent_beacon_block_root` to CL's `ExecutionPayload`/`Header`. But if we make the simple change, to try to do so quickly. Going to get this PR cleaned up by tmw -- https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3454 Plus an Engine API update. CL teams, please give a thumbs-up or down in the PR if you have sentiment one way or another. And please speak up more loudly with comments in the PR if you feel against If can get general approvals, we'll cut a release before ACDC next week. otherwise, we'll have to touch on it there engine api update for 3454: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/441 checking suggestions on 3454
